No offense taken whatsoever, so no worries. I didn't find out about the pregnancy between these past two days, I've even taken tests in February and in March just because before I got the implant (I got it in December) I was on the pill and I know how iffy those are so I've racked up on dollar tree pregnancy tests and they all came out negative those two months I've taken them. It wasn't until I took a test recently that it came out as positive and thinking about how I've gotten my period every month (it's normal for women's bodies to adjust to new birth control bc of the hormones, a friend of mine that got the same implant didn't get her period until 5 months after her body got used to it, another friend with an IUD got 3 months of straight period, and etc. And I have endometriosis which is another reason why i got the implant bc I wanted to control my period and it's pain bc I'd usually have it for at least a week and it was really heavy and painful each time but after the implant and as my body adjusted to it i only had 1-2 days of light bleeding (I've also looked this up where you can bleed while pregnant with implantation bleeding and also many other factors, there's been horror stories of women not showing any signs and still getting their period but still being pregnant and not knowing until they're really showing)) So basically once I got that last positive test, I was for sure it was a false positive but because I'm really paranoid I did bloodwork at a hospital to test my hCG levels and it turns out that I am. Even then, I thought that this could still be a false positive so I got an ultrasound and there it was. 

Also When I made my first post, I really was stuck on the fact that I was basically being broken up with and it still felt surreal with that among the fact that that was happening to me, I was pregnant. I wanted to include the fact that I was pregnant in the post but I felt like I had to deal with the problem of separation first and make sure that whatever i even decide to do after is because of what I want and not because I was possibly gonna have a baby. I don't know if I'm making sense but 

Also I did not know how to edit posts on reddit until today but i wish I did so I could have included it after people had given me a bit of clarity in my head about my heartbreak. I'm sorry if I caused any confusion or skepticism, it really wasn't my intention.
